summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with a Note on coordinate format; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with NumPy-based worker split and the exact missing-len NotImplementedError; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_len). Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified; the two-worker pinned values are the most likely to need adjustment. Nothing was committed. Pre-existing docstring lines over 120 characters in get_valid_patch_size were left untouched.
